name: time
title: Time (official MCP time server)
description: The official MCP time server (mcp-server-time 2026.10.28, modelcontextprotocol/servers): get_current_time gives the current date, time, weekday and daylight-saving state of an IANA time zone, convert_time converts a wall-clock time (HH:MM, today) from one zone to another with the offset between them. Models do not know the current date or time and get time zone arithmetic wrong; this answers both exactly. The local zone the tools name is LOCAL_TIMEZONE (else UTC). Zone names checked, answers small, no network, nothing read or written.
license: MIT AND Apache-2.0 (modelcontextprotocol/servers, in transition from MIT to Apache-2.0); MCP Python SDK: MIT; tzdata: Apache-2.0; tzlocal: MIT

env.name: LOCAL_TIMEZONE
env.description: the user's IANA time zone, e.g. Europe/Berlin (default UTC); named to the model as its local zone

notes: Two tools with small schemas: suited to small local models. The current time is the container's clock, which is the host's. A model is told to use the local zone when the user names none, so set LOCAL_TIMEZONE to yours.

tor.note: No network: it reaches nothing, so nothing of it goes through Tor (sandbox-ai gives a server without network no VPN).
